name: Newhaven, General Store
desc1: This large wooden shack carries all sorts of useful goods. A big,
desc2: long-haired man sits behind a counter whistling to himself, and smiles
desc3: at you as you enter. The general store is a necessary shop for
desc4: adventurers, as it sells light sources used to explore murky caverns.
desc5: You can leave the shop through the open doorway to the north.
